With the now infamous Infantino scandal, football escaped very narrowly what would have been an irreversible disaster. 

For now.

Who knows where the game would have ended up with Trump’s family as part-owners of its commercial rights. The game would be part of the Trump arsenal, in service of the US, any pretence of global balance subservient to US interests and that of the closely-aligned investors.

We can be assured that World Cup rotation would be finished, if Infantino hasn’t killed it already with his capitulation to Saudi interests, that Trump-friendly countries would be favored, that we’d see many more vacuous, invented awards for Trump allies, and a successor to Infantino installed.

Temu-Trump Infantino simply applied the same rules - disregarding all conventions and processes, considering himself unbound by scrutiny, attacking detractors and his own version of ‘fake news’, using the institution as a personal public relations tool.

The fact that he seeks to operate with the same disregard of process is not a surprise, but it is a threat.

The list of scandal-plagued FIFA presidents and administrations is long. But this is historically one of the worst because it affected the actual ownership and control of the game itself. 

Any Federation therefore, that continues to support Infantino after his attempted commercial coup is fundamentally broken.

Infantino must go. Of that there is no doubt.

If he was to survive this crisis, the game has given up any pretence of representation.

But the deeper problem is structural. The real failure is not only that one person went this far, but that the institution and its members allowed him to.

Football requires safeguards that limit presidential overreach and break the very longstanding pattern of personalised power and political abuse of its resources.

The three Confederations’ joint letter correctly names the core failure: leadership that places itself above the collective, and a sycophantic and spineless organisation that has no sense of its broader responsibilities.

The question is, what’s the path to reform. 

Not just to another rinse, and repeat.

暂时如此。

谁知道如果 Trump 的家族成为其商业权利的部分所有者，这项运动最终会走向哪里。足球会成为 Trump 武器库的一部分，为美国服务，任何全球平衡的假象都会从属于美国利益以及那些紧密结盟的投资者的利益。

我们可以确定，世界杯轮办将会终结——如果 Infantino 还没有因向沙特利益屈服而把它扼杀的话；亲 Trump 的国家会受到优待；我们会看到更多空洞、凭空捏造的奖项颁给 Trump 的盟友；还会安插一个 Infantino 的继任者。

Temu-Trump Infantino 只是套用了同样的规则——无视一切惯例和流程，认为自己不受审查约束，攻击批评者和他自己版本的“假新闻”，把这个机构当作个人公关工具。

他试图以同样无视流程的方式运作，这并不令人意外，但这是一种威胁。

丑闻缠身的 FIFA 主席和管理层名单很长。但从历史上看，这是最糟糕的事件之一，因为它影响的是这项运动本身的实际所有权和控制权。

因此，任何在 Infantino 企图发动商业政变之后仍继续支持他的足协，根本上都是坏掉的。

Infantino 必须下台。对此毫无疑问。

如果他能挺过这场危机，这项运动就已经放弃了任何代表性的伪装。

但更深层的问题是结构性的。真正的失败不仅在于一个人走到了这一步，还在于这个机构及其成员允许他这样做。

足球需要保障机制，限制主席越权，并打破长期以来个人化权力和政治滥用其资源的模式。

三大洲足联的联合信正确指出了核心失败：把自身置于集体之上的领导层，以及一个谄媚、没骨气、对自身更广泛责任毫无意识的组织。

问题是，改革之路在哪里。

而不是又一次洗一遍，然后重复。

With the now infamous Infantino scandal, football escaped very narrowly what would have been an irreversible disaster. 

For now.

Who knows where the game would have ended up with Trump’s family as part-owners of its commercial rights. The game would be part of the Trump arsenal, in service of the US, any pretence of global balance subservient to US interests and that of the closely-aligned investors.

We can be assured that World Cup rotation would be finished, if Infantino hasn’t killed it already with his capitulation to Saudi interests, that Trump-friendly countries would be favored, that we’d see many more vacuous, invented awards for Trump allies, and a successor to Infantino installed.

Temu-Trump Infantino simply applied the same rules - disregarding all conventions and processes, considering himself unbound by scrutiny, attacking detractors and his own version of ‘fake news’, using the institution as a personal public relations tool.

The fact that he seeks to operate with the same disregard of process is not a surprise, but it is a threat.

The list of scandal-plagued FIFA presidents and administrations is long. But this is historically one of the worst because it affected the actual ownership and control of the game itself. 

Any Federation therefore, that continues to support Infantino after his attempted commercial coup is fundamentally broken.

Infantino must go. Of that there is no doubt.

If he was to survive this crisis, the game has given up any pretence of representation.

But the deeper problem is structural. The real failure is not only that one person went this far, but that the institution and its members allowed him to.

Football requires safeguards that limit presidential overreach and break the very longstanding pattern of personalised power and political abuse of its resources.

The three Confederations’ joint letter correctly names the core failure: leadership that places itself above the collective, and a sycophantic and spineless organisation that has no sense of its broader responsibilities.

The question is, what’s the path to reform. 

Not just to another rinse, and repeat.

随着如今臭名昭著的 Infantino 丑闻，足球非常惊险地避开了一场本会无法挽回的灾难。

暂时如此。

谁知道如果 Trump 的家族成为其商业权利的部分所有者，这项运动最终会走向哪里。足球会成为 Trump 武器库的一部分，为美国服务，任何全球平衡的假象都会从属于美国利益以及那些紧密结盟的投资者的利益。

我们可以确定，世界杯轮办将会终结——如果 Infantino 还没有因向沙特利益屈服而把它扼杀的话；亲 Trump 的国家会受到优待；我们会看到更多空洞、凭空捏造的奖项颁给 Trump 的盟友；还会安插一个 Infantino 的继任者。

Temu-Trump Infantino 只是套用了同样的规则——无视一切惯例和流程，认为自己不受审查约束，攻击批评者和他自己版本的“假新闻”，把这个机构当作个人公关工具。

他试图以同样无视流程的方式运作，这并不令人意外，但这是一种威胁。

丑闻缠身的 FIFA 主席和管理层名单很长。但从历史上看，这是最糟糕的事件之一，因为它影响的是这项运动本身的实际所有权和控制权。

因此，任何在 Infantino 企图发动商业政变之后仍继续支持他的足协，根本上都是坏掉的。

Infantino 必须下台。对此毫无疑问。

如果他能挺过这场危机，这项运动就已经放弃了任何代表性的伪装。

但更深层的问题是结构性的。真正的失败不仅在于一个人走到了这一步，还在于这个机构及其成员允许他这样做。

足球需要保障机制，限制主席越权，并打破长期以来个人化权力和政治滥用其资源的模式。

三大洲足联的联合信正确指出了核心失败：把自身置于集体之上的领导层，以及一个谄媚、没骨气、对自身更广泛责任毫无意识的组织。

问题是，改革之路在哪里。

而不是又一次洗一遍，然后重复。
